learning_outcomes.text: Allow the student to practically apply the knowledge acquired in their academic training, preparing them for the exercise of professional activities.
Promote the acquisition of competencies that prepare them for the exercise of professional activities, facilitate their employability, and foster their entrepreneurial capacity.
Contribute to the comprehensive education of students, complementing their theoretical and practical teachings.
Facilitate knowledge of the appropriate work methodology for the professional reality in which students will operate as graduates, contrasting and applying acquired knowledge.
Prepare students for teamwork. Foster the development of decision-making capacity and critical thinking in students.
Describe and evaluate the functioning of the organization they are introduced to.
Integrate into the organization, collaborate and perform the tasks assigned to them.
Search for data, information, and necessary collaboration for the assigned project.
Analyze the economic, social, and environmental implications of possible alternatives to a given problem.
Argue and defend their opinions, and accept the solutions reached by their work team.
Develop the adopted solution for the project, within the framework of their work team.

assessment_methods.method: Company tutor's evaluation of student competencies

assessment_rules: All assessment components are non-recoverable. No minimum grades are specified for individual components.
